intro: A practical map of the core concepts you will reuse across neuroscience research, neurotech prototyping, and data-driven analysis.

pillars.title: Neurons and synapses
pillars.summary: Cellular building blocks that generate and transmit neural signals.

pillars.title: Neural circuits and computation
pillars.summary: How networks of neurons encode, transform, and route information.

pillars.title: Systems neuroscience
pillars.summary: Large-scale organization of sensory, motor, and autonomic systems.

pillars.title: Cognition and behavior
pillars.summary: Higher-level processes that connect brain activity to decisions and actions.

pillars.title: Clinical and translational neuroscience
pillars.summary: Applying neuroscience to health, disease, and therapy development.

modalities.label: EEG
modalities.summary: Scalp electrical recordings with high temporal resolution.

modalities.label: MEG
modalities.summary: Magnetic fields from neural activity with millisecond precision.

modalities.label: fMRI
modalities.summary: Hemodynamic responses with high spatial resolution.

modalities.label: fNIRS
modalities.summary: Portable optical measurement of cortical hemodynamics.

modalities.label: ECoG and iEEG
modalities.summary: Intracranial recordings with high spatial and temporal resolution.

learningPath.title: Build the biological core
learningPath.details: Start with neurons, synapses, and the basic physiology of signaling.

learningPath.title: Connect circuits to behavior
learningPath.details: Learn how circuits support perception, movement, and cognition.

learningPath.title: Choose a primary modality
learningPath.details: Go deep on one measurement method and learn its analysis workflow.

learningPath.title: Practice with real data
learningPath.details: Reproduce a published analysis or build a small decoding pipeline.
